item.title: Sen. Darline Graham projected to win runoff in South Carolina GOP Senate primary
item.description: Sen. Darline Graham won the GOP Senate runoff in South Carolina on Tuesday night, CBS News projects, defeating Rep. Ralph Norman in the special primary to replace Graham's late brother, Sen. Lindsey Graham, on the ballot.

item.title: July PCE inflation index held at 3.7% annual pace, hotter than expected
item.description: The Personal Consumption Expenditures index was unchanged from June, highlighting stubborn inflationary pressures.

item.title: Americans among almost 400 tourists missing after Nepal flash flood
item.description: Flash floods tore through a valley in Nepal, sweeping away villages and hundreds of tourists, with Americans among the missing, authorities say.

item.title: Highlighting Dolly Parton's philanthropy
item.description: Dolly Parton's philanthropic legacy rivals her musical one, especially with her book-gifting program, "Dolly Parton's Imagination Library." Adriana Diaz reports.

item.title: Fans at Dollywood mourn and celebrate Dolly Parton: "There's a piece of my heart gone"
item.description: Dolly Parton fans across the U.S. are mourning and celebrating the icon after her death at 80. Skyler Henry reports.

item.title: Dolly Parton's life and legacy
item.description: Dolly Parton died at 80 years old after a brief battle with cancer. Anthony Mason reports on her life and legacy.

item.title: Prince Harry and Meghan returning to the U.K. today, BBC News reports
item.description: Prince Harry and Meghan, the Duke and Duchess of Sussex, are returning to the U.K. from California today, six years after their tumultuous departure, the BBC reports.

item.title: Eye Opener: Tributes pour in for Dolly Parton
item.description: The nation is remembering Dolly Parton after her death at 80. All that and all that matters in today's Eye Opener.

item.title: Ross Fire explodes to over 80,000 acres, forces evacuations in North Texas
item.description: The Ross wildfire has burned more than 80,000 acres across Palo Pinto and Jack counties, forcing evacuations, closing roads and disrupting schools.

item.title: Iran, Oman edge toward Strait of Hormuz reopening plan, but Tehran demands U.S. lift blockade
item.description: The two nations, which lie on opposite sides of the vital, narrow waterway, discussed a proposal to temporarily reopen it and clear mines.

item.title: Dolly Parton explains why she's "almost like three people" | 60 Minutes Archive
item.description: Dolly Parton took 60 Minutes' Morley Safer on a tour through her Chasing Rainbows Museum in 2009. She discussed her identity as a singer and as a businessperson.

item.title: Enes Kanter Freedom banned from home games of WNBA's Chicago Sky
item.description: The 6-foot-10, 250-pound former NBA player was removed from Sunday's game after he was confronted by Sky guard Natasha Cloud.

item.title: Secrets of the gut microbiome and how it impacts our long-term brain health
item.description: Dr. Laura Cox, an assistant professor at Brigham and Women's Hospital and Harvard Medical School, explains how our dietary patterns play a significant role in our gut and long-term brain health.

item.title: The Secret Lies in the Gut
item.description: Laurie Cox spends her day investigating the role of the gut microbiota in neurologic diseases like Alzheimer's and Parkinson's. This week, she joins Norah to discuss the role the gut microbiome plays in aging and disease, and why her work could lead to more personalized medicine as we learn more about the connection between the gut, hormones and women's health. Plus, Norah shares what she eats in the morning to jumpstart her gut!

item.title: Slain girl hailed as hero after 8 relatives killed in Montana home
item.description: The victims represented four generations of the blended family, ranging from a great-grandmother in her 90s who used a wheelchair to a 7-year-old girl, a neighbor said.

item.title: Russia says CIA chief met intel counterparts on secretive Moscow visit
item.description: The Kremlin spokesman says CIA Director John Ratcliffe met Russian counterparts during a secretive visit to Moscow, but it's unclear what came of the talks.

item.title: 14 newborns killed as fire tears through Pakistani hospital's nursery
item.description: Authorities in Islamabad, Pakistan, say a fire caused by an air-conditioning unit exploding in a major hospital nursery ward killed 14 newborns.

item.title: Man with Sen. Dan Sullivan's name advances from Alaska U.S. Senate primary
item.description: A man with the same name as Alaska's incumbent U.S. Sen. Dan Sullivan has advanced to the general election

item.title: Dolly Parton remembered by fellow stars, politicans: "A true loss for millions"
item.description: President Trump said that he would be "lowering the American flag" throughout the nation for one week in Dolly Parton's honor.

item.title: U.S. military attacks alleged drug-smuggling boat in Caribbean, killing 4
item.description: The attack brings the number of people killed in such strikes by the U.S. military in the eastern Pacific Ocean and Caribbean Sea to at least 227.

item.title: Country singer Ashley McBryde on Dolly Parton's impact: "She was the pedestal"
item.description: Country singer Ashley McBryde joins CBS News after Dolly Parton's death at 80 to discuss her impact on music and the Nashville country scene.

item.title: Cher speaks out after Dolly Parton's death, describes their first meeting
item.description: Grammy-award winning artist Cher spoke about Dolly Parton after the country legend's death at 80 Tuesday. Cher told CBS News about their first meeting and what she loved about Parton. She said she'll miss Parton's laugh the most.

item.title: Watch: Jon Batiste plays beautiful musical tribute to Dolly Parton
item.description: Jon Batiste performed a musical tribute to the late country music superstar Dolly Parton, who died Tuesday at age 80 after a brief battle with cancer.

item.title: Dolly Parton, country music legend, dies at 80 after brief cancer battle
item.description: Dolly Parton became an icon over her six-decade career as a Grammy-winning singer-songwriter, movie and TV star and theme park owner who donated millions to help others.

item.title: Iran says it's ready for new U.S. sanctions, has 2-year plan
item.description: Iran's economy minister said the country has been preparing for a long time for the sanctions U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent described as the "greatest financial offensive" ever.

item.title: Philadelphia's Chucky-style masked man arrested in Las Vegas
item.description: U.S. Marshals say 22-year-old Zymire Hughes was arrested Tuesday night in Las Vegas, Nevada.

item.title: Judge delays custody decision in surrogacy fight over newborn with heart defect
item.description: Dallas judge has delayed a custody decision, extending a temporary restraining order another two weeks as the legal fight over custody of a baby with a rare heart defect born to a surrogate continues.

item.title: College student fatally shot by police after knocking on wrong door
item.description: Glenn Pysher was trying to find his friends when he accidentally knocked on the door of the wrong house. The homeowners called 911 to report an attempted break-in.

item.title: Everton Blair wins special election for late Rep. David Scott's seat
item.description: Everton Blair Jr. will serve out the remaining few months of the late Rep. David Scott's final term, the Associated Press projects.

item.title: At least 1 in 4 ex-NFL players who died from 2016 to 2021 had CTE, study finds
item.description: The rate is much higher than is seen in the general population. CTE is a brain disease linked to repeated blows to the head.
